inc-bot: INCIDENT 🔔 — Elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts observed in eu-central ingress cluster. Alerting oncall and paging SREs. metrics: 5xx rate up to 12% over last 3m, p95 latency spike. paging: maria

maria (oncall): saw the alert come through, looking now. can someone drop a quick impact TL;DR?

kevin (support): customer-facing: small set of customers in EU report errors on inference endpoints. support ticket volume up ~x3. attaching sample error: `Failed to open connection: upstream reset (502)`

raj (eng-infra): checking health of ingress proxies. looks like one ASG in eu-central is flapping scaling quickly, a few pods are OOM/killed. i'm seeing a lot of `connection reset by peer` in the proxy logs.

beth (eng-runtime): could be KV cache pressure + a burst of long sequences. if proxies are overloaded, requests backpressure into model workers causing timeouts. recommend immediate circuit-breaker to slow requests to backend and steer traffic.

maria (oncall): ok actions: 1) set ingress circuit breaker to failfast for slow upstreams 2) shift ~30% traffic from eu-central to eu-west for burst 3) scale up proxy pool and drain bad instances 4) notify customers in impacted cohort. who's on the steer?

raj (eng-infra): i'll run the steer. starting with a temporary route override. applying weight change: `kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: networking.internal/v1
kind: TrafficSplit
metadata:
  name: ingress-split
spec:
  backends:
  - service: ingress-eu-central
    weight: 70
  - service: ingress-eu-west
    weight: 30
EOF`

beth (eng-runtime): also enabling envoy circuit breaker on upstream cluster: `max_connections: 200` `max_pending_requests: 50` and setting `retry_policy` to 0 for now. patching now.

maria (oncall): raj, confirm when steer completes. kevin, start a short status note for impacted customers (internal only) — list service prefixes and % errors.

raj (eng-infra): steer applied. verified via metrics: eu-central request rate down ~28%, eu-west up accordingly. watch dashboards: https://dashboards.internal/ingress/region-eu

inc-bot: deploy bot — rollout started: `deployment/ingress-proxy` in namespace prod -> restart initiated by raj. Monitor for restarts.

raj (eng-infra): rolling restart command used: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/ingress-proxy -n prod --selector=region=eu-central`

beth (eng-runtime): while restarts go, i've activated prefix/KV cache warmup on eu-west to avoid cold starts. also disabled chunked batching on proxied long-running requests to keep per-request memory bounded.

kevin (support): customer impact note draft: "We are currently mitigating elevated error rates in EU region and shifting traffic to alternate region. Some requests may see increased latency; a subset of customers may experience transient 5xx. Our engineering team is actively working on a fix." sending to affected accounts now.

maria (oncall): monitoring: after steer + circuit-breaker + restarts, 5xx rate in eu-central dropped from 12% -> 3% over 6m, p95 latency falling. any sign of bad nodes still?

raj (eng-infra): one node still flapping, evicting it from pool (cordon + drain). `kubectl cordon node-az3-euc-02 && kubectl drain node-az3-euc-02 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

beth (eng-runtime): logs show repeated `worker: kv_cache_hit_rate drop` followed by long tail requests — likely hotspot in the cache index. i'm collecting heap snapshots from model workers for post-incident analysis.

maria (oncall): good. switch to monitoring-only updates every 5m. kevin, include customer update that we've reduced failures and are continuing investigation.

kevin (support): update sent. customers on support channel acknowledged and asked for ETA. i'll say: "monitoring, ETA under investigation; will update in 30m"

inc-bot: Paging update — oncall acknowledged by maria at +2m.

beth (eng-runtime): quick mitigation note for postmortem: temporary edges: 1) circuit-breaker introduced 2) route-weight split to eu-west 3) restart and drain of flapping nodes 4) cache warmup. Preserve logs and related snapshots.

raj (eng-infra): i've also opened a short-lived iptables rule to drop unhealthy upstreams to avoid noisy retries: `iptables -I INPUT -m conntrack --ctstate INVALID -j DROP` (applied on edge nodes).

maria (oncall): summary for handoff: current state = degraded but stable. impact = partial regional outage affecting EU ingestion endpoints, ~3% 5xx currently, customer-visible but mitigated. next steps for owners: beth -> deep runtime mem/kv analysis; raj -> infra autoscaling and node flapping RCA; kevin -> finalize customer comms; i'll own incident timeline and postmortem.

kevin (support): documenting affected customers list and severity classification. will attach sample request IDs in the incident ticket.

maria (oncall): handing off to follow-up owners. if anything regresses, re-open here and page. thanks all. :thumbsup:

beth (eng-runtime): leaving a note: suspected root cause — cache index bloat after a new quantization entry in the model cache caused memory pressure in a subset of workers, triggering long GC pauses and subsequent upstream resets to the ingress. collecting repro and heapdumps.

raj (eng-infra): also collecting autoscaler events + ASG scaling logs. filing a ticket for more conservative scale-up thresholds.

inc-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (mitigation in place) — keep thread for postmortem notes.

maria (oncall): incident resolved -> moving to postmortem channel and scheduling follow-up.
